data.content_ref: inline:SRC_04 argues that decentralized services mask shared infrastructure dependencies (DNS, cloud, BGP), but its own countercondition concedes the issue vanishes under heterogeneous infrastructure. The argument does not establish that decentralized small services are necessarily or typically co-located on shared substrate; it provides no causal mechanism for why a decentralized network of independently operated services would converge on the same infrastructure provider, nor does it compare whether a large service with strictly more total internal redundancy can realistically avoid those same shared primitives.
